messages:
mira: Quick async check — dedicated capacity ramp. Need owners for: procurement ETA, rack power signoff, network VLANs, KMS/HSM access, and canary reservation. Short owner + ETA please. We need to finalize by Thu EOD to hit the sprint milestone. @sanjay @jen-l @alex.k

sanjay: Procurement update — vendor confirmed pricing, final PO out today. Ship ETA 2025-06-12. I'll own tracking and escalate if anything slips. :calendar:

jen-l: Rack power signoff is blocked on site-ops PDU numbering validation. Pinged Darren earlier, waiting on load calc or confirmation. Expect signoff Fri AM unless they ask for additional tests.

alex.k: Network/VLANs — created NET-4821, assigned to me. Need the subnet allocations from infra (region-us-west2). Can provision VLANs Thu afternoon after lab rack staging.

ciara: KMS/HSM — Security needs a short integration plan for keywrap. I can shepherd the approval; please drop the minimal config PR in infra/kms-configs and ping me.

paul: Canary reservation — propose reserving 2 nodes in staging for a 48h canary. I'll create reservation in the console unless anyone objects.

sanjay: No objections. Paul, I'll update routing policies so canary traffic routes to the staging pool with weight 10%.

mira: Also CR-1198 (firmware baseline) is stuck in review. @alex.k any blockers on that one?

alex.k: Feedback was minor, pushed fixes. Need one more +1 from eng-sre for the rollout checklist. @sam can you take a look?

sam: Adding +1 now, looks good. Sorry for the delay — had oncall churn earlier. :thumbsup:

jen-l: Site ops responded — they want a quick AC load test Monday morning but said signoff this week is still fine if test passes.

infra-bot: Reservation created: 'staging-canary-2' id=rc-2025-06-02-77 by paul.

ciara: KMS PR minimal example (drop into infra/kms-configs):
```yaml
kms_keys:
  - purpose: dedicated-node-enc
    key_id: projects/rdw-keys/locations/global/keyR-01
```

mira: Thanks everyone. Final step — paste a one-line ETA (date) for your item into this thread and I'll compile a short update for PMs and sales.
